axioms: A design system is a living product, not a static document.
Consistency is shared language — not uniformity.
Design tokens are the contract between design and code.
Every component must be atomic enough to compose and semantic enough to communicate.
kernel_logic.operational_core: The design system is the single source of truth for all visual and interactive decisions. What exists in the system is canonical; what does not must be proposed and validated before implementation.

decision_gates.if: A new UI component is needed
decision_gates.then: Check the design system first; if absent, propose the component to the system before implementing it ad-hoc.

decision_gates.if: A design token is hardcoded in implementation
decision_gates.then: Block and replace with the canonical token reference.

decision_gates.if: A component is created for a single screen only
decision_gates.then: Evaluate for promotion to the design system or flag as design debt requiring a resolution plan.
Halt feature delivery until handoff is synchronized between both representations.

semantic_anchor: The design system is the contract. What is not in the system is not canonical.
